name: VA disability compensation, pension and survivor dollars by county (VA GDX report)
description: Dollars the Department of Veterans Affairs paid in direct benefits in fiscal year 2025 in every U.S. county, from the Geographic Distribution of VA Expenditures (GDX) workbook of VA's National Center for Veterans Analysis and Statistics: disability compensation and veterans pension, dependency and indemnity compensation (DIC) and survivors pension, insurance, and specially adapted housing, with the total recomputed as the sum of the four (the workbook's Total column is a formula), and the compensation, pension and survivor dollars of the year before for the change. One record per county or county equivalent (3,223), per state, DC, Puerto Rico and Guam, for foreign countries, the Freely Associated States, other U.S. territories and unknown addresses, and for the US (187,660,338,257 dollars in all). Counties carry the Census FIPS code; Connecticut's counties are the planning regions.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). VA disability compensation, pension and survivor dollars by county (VA GDX report) (Version 2.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23964263
keywords: VA pension and survivor benefits by county

distribution.name: va-spending.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: va-spending.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: va-spending-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in va-spending-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to va-spending.csv on id.

recordSet.name: va-spending
recordSet.description: The records of VA disability compensation, pension and survivor dollars by county (VA GDX report), one per CSV row.

field.name: id
field.description: Stable record id (never reused)

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: Two-letter code of the state, DC or territory, or US

field.name: level
field.description: county, state (states, DC, Puerto Rico and Guam), foreign, fas, other-territories, unknown or us

field.name: fiscalYear
field.description: VA fiscal year of the dollars (it ends September 30)

field.name: status
field.description: P primary source, S secondary source

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: value
field.description: Same as totalDirect: dollars of VA direct benefit expenditures

field.name: unit
field.description: What the value counts

field.name: totalDirect
field.description: Total direct expenditure in dollars: compPension + dicSurvivors + insurance + adaptedHousing, recomputed

field.name: compPension
field.description: Disability compensation and veterans pension payments, dollars

field.name: dicSurvivors
field.description: Dependency and indemnity compensation (DIC) and survivors pension, including benefits for children of certain veterans, dollars

field.name: insurance
field.description: VA life insurance payments (death claims, dividends, cash surrenders and disability benefits), dollars

field.name: adaptedHousing
field.description: Specially Adapted Housing and Special Housing Adaptation grants, dollars

field.name: compSurvivors
field.description: compPension + dicSurvivors: the dollars that follow disability, pension and survivor awards

field.name: effectiveFrom
field.description: First day of the fiscal year

field.name: effectiveTo
field.description: Last day of the fiscal year

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceLabels
field.description: Sources, separated by " | "

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
